name: task-management-manager
description:
Ships a config-driven task-management hook suite — guard task deletion, enforce the done/backlog invariant, nudge to track work, and check task-file consistency. Each hook is a no-op unless the repo's .claude/hooks/task-management.conf opts it in.

Try asking...
- What does the task-management hook suite do?
- How do I turn on task tracking for this repo?
- Why was my task deletion blocked?
- Where do the task-file paths and markers come from?
